t.name: Mount Ellinor Trail #812
t.description: This trail is steep and rocky as it climbs to specatular views of Lake Cushman, Puget Sound, and the interior Olympic Mountains.

t.name: Mount Rose Trail #814
t.description: A steep trail to a rocky perch with views of Lake Cushman and the southeastern corner of the Olympic Mountains.

t.name: Copper Creek Trail #876
t.description: This is a steep 2.1 mile trail that forms a short loop at the ridge top. At 1.3 miles the trail branches and ascends to the ridge crest separating the Copper Creek and Elk Creek watersheds and then loops back down to the trail branch.

t.name: Dry Creek Trail #872
t.description: The trail follows the shoreline of Lake Cushman before climbing over Dry Creek Pass and descending to Forest Road 2353-200.

t.name: Duckabush River Trail
t.description: This backcountry trail follows the Duckabush River from the park boundary to O'Neil Pass.

t.name: LaCrosse Pass Trail
t.description: Steep mountain trail climbong over LaCrosse Pass connecting the Duckabush River to the West Fork Dosewallips Trail.

t.name: O'Neil Pass Trail
t.description: Trail connectiing the Quinault River Trail to O'Neil Pass and the Duckabush River Trail.

t.name: Mount Hopper Way Trail
t.description: Primitive poorly maintained way trail that ends near Mount Hopper

t.name: North Fork Skokomish River Trail
t.description: The ttail follows the North Fork Skokomish River from Staircase to First Divide where it connects to the Home Sweet Home Trail.

m: Black and White Lakes Primitive Trail

t.name: Home Sweet Home Trail
t.description: Mountain trail connecting the Duckabush River Trail to First Divide and the North Fork Skokomish River Trail.

t.name: Six Ridge Primitive Trail
t.description: Primitive poorly maintained way trail that connects the North Fork Skokomish Trail to the Wynoochee Pass area.

t.name: Smith Lake Primitive Trail
t.description: Trail leads past Black and White Lakes to Smith Lake.

m: Black and White Lakes Primitive Trail

t.name: Gladys Divide Primitive Trail
t.description: Primiitive trail that ascends from Flapjack Lakes to Gladys Divide.

t.name: Flapjack Lakes Trail
t.description: Moderate climb through the forest to a pair of apline lakes with the rugged Sawtooth Range looming above.

t.name: Staircase Rapids Loop Trail
t.description: 2 miles with a bridge over the Skokomish River, and nice forest and river views. Starts near ranger station

t.name: Wagonwheel Lake Trail
t.description: Very steep trail to a subalpine lake.

t.name: South Fork Skokomish River Trail 873
t.description: This trail wanders through old growth forest and crosses the South Fork Skokomish River and other streamss befoe climbing up the national park boundary.

t.name: East Fork Quinault River Trail
t.description: a long trail leading up the valley of the Quinault River to Enchanted Valley and the alpine slopes of Anderson Pass.

t.name: Hart Lake Way Trail
t.description: Short trail leads to Hart Lake.

t.name: LaCrosse Basin Way Trail
t.description: This trail leads up into the alpine valley of LaCrosse Basin and LaCrosse Lake.

t.name: West Fork Dosewallips River Trail
t.description: The trail begins at Dose Forks and climbs up the valley of the West Fork Dosewallips River to Anderson Pass.

t.name: Anderson Moraine Primitive Trail
t.description: Short trail leading up to the Anderson Glacier Moraine for views of Mount Anderson and the remants of the Anderson Glacier.

t.name: Home Sweet Home Camp Trail
t.description: Short trail leading to the Home Sweet Home campsite.

t.name: Mildred Lakes Trail #822
t.description: The Mildred Lakes trail is a boot path made by the feet of many hikers and fishermen. It is a root-strewn climb to the lakes. In places, it becomes steep and difficult to follow.

t.name: Putvin Trail #813
t.description: This trail climbs steeply up the side of the Hamma Hamma River Valley before entering the national park and cresting at the Lake of the Angels.

t.name: Dosewallips River Trail
t.description: The trail follows the main fork of the Dosewallips River from the Dose Ranger Station to Hayden Pass.

t.name: Black and White Lakes Primitive Trail
